gitCommit.subject: fix: GET /api/items/[id] returns 404 not 500 for an absent item (#216)
gitCommit.body:
fix: GET /api/items/[id] returns 404 not 500 for an absent item (#216)

* fix(items): GET /api/items/[id] returns 404 (not 500) for an absent item

getItem now returns Item|null (was throwing a generic Error caught as 500);
the route maps null -> 404. Found by the u3p purge e2e. + route test (404/200/401).
